PARAMS = {
    "I1":     (16e-6, 6e-6, 30e-6),   # gm stage current
    "L1":     (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),       # gm stage device L
    "Iinv":   (13e-6, 5e-6, 25e-6),   # inverter (TIA) current
    "gmid_n": (15.0, 8.0, 22.0),      # inverter NMOS gm/Id (sets trip point Vm)
    "Linv":   (0.25, 0.15, 0.6),      # inverter L (cap vs loop gain)
    "Rf":     (85e3, 30e3, 250e3),    # feedback resistor -> gain ~ gm1*Rf
}

def _bisect(f, lo, hi, target, it=50):
    # f decreasing in x; find x with f(x)=target (clamped)
    flo, fhi = f(lo), f(hi)
    if target >= flo: return lo
    if target <= fhi: return hi
    for _ in range(it):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if f(mid) > target: lo = mid
        else: hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Iinv, Linv, Rf = p["Iinv"], p["Linv"], p["Rf"]

    # --- inverter: NMOS sets trip point Vm, PMOS gm/Id solved so VSGp = VDD - Vm
    Vm = 0.8
    for _ in range(3):
        mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], Linv, Iinv, vds=Vm)
        Vm = mn.vgs
    gp = _bisect(lambda g: lut.size("p", g, Linv, Iinv, vds=VDD - Vm).vgs,
                 3.0, 15.5, VDD - Vm)
    mp = lut.size("p", gp, Linv, Iinv, vds=VDD - Vm)

    # --- gm device: gm/Id chosen so VGS = vin_dc exactly at Id = I1
    gm1 = _bisect(lambda g: lut.size("n", g, p["L1"], p["I1"], vds=Vm).vgs,
                  3.0, 25.0, vin)
    m1 = lut.size("n", gm1, p["L1"], p["I1"], vds=Vm)
    I1 = m1.Id
    RL = (VDD - Vm) / I1            # load current = I1 -> no DC current in Rf -> vout = Vm

    # --- ibias sink (IREF must have a DC path)
    mb = lut.size("n", 6.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1, m=max(1, int(m1.W / 10) + 1))
    n.R("RL", "vdd", "n1", RL)
    n.dev("MN", "vout", "n1", "vss", "vss", mn, m=max(1, int(mn.W / 10) + 1))
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", mp, m=max(1, int(mp.W / 10) + 1))
    n.R("RF", "n1", "vout", Rf)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    # --- 2-node small-signal model
    gmi = mn.gm + mp.gm
    Go = mn.gds + mp.gds
    G1 = m1.gds + 1.0 / RL
    Cf = mn.cgd + mp.cgd
    C1 = max(mn.cgg + mp.cgg - Cf, 0.0) + m1.cdd
    C2 = CL + mn.cdd + mp.cdd
    gf = 1.0 / Rf
    def H(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        Y = np.array([[G1 + gf + s * (C1 + Cf + m1.cgd), -gf - s * Cf],
                      [gmi - gf - s * Cf, Go + gf + s * (C2 + Cf)]], dtype=complex)
        rhs = np.array([-(m1.gm - s * m1.cgd), 0.0], dtype=complex)
        return np.linalg.solve(Y, rhs)[1]
    fs = np.logspace(3, 10.5, 600)
    mag = np.array([abs(H(f)) for f in fs])
    A0 = mag[0]
    idx = np.where(mag < A0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3 = fs[idx[0]] if len(idx) else fs[-1]

    power = VDD * (I1 + Iinv + iref)
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A0),
        "f3db": f3,
        "gbw": A0 * f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": Vm,
        "swing": 1.2,
    }
